newsitem.title: USA: Home Depot reviews offer on Reno-Depot.
newsitem.headline: Home Depot reviews offer on Reno-Depot.

text.p: The Home Depot said on Tuesday it is reviewing Molson Cos Ltd's decision to sell its indirect interest in Reno-Depot Inc, a home improvement products retailer in Quebec.
Under the terms of an existing agreement, Home Depot has a right of first offer, including the ability to accept such offers within 45 days of notice from Molson, Home Depot said.
Home Depot said it will not comment on speculation of acquisitions or other material future activities.
Molson holds 50 percent of a holding company that owns 90.2 percent of the shares of Reno Depot for C$62.25 million. The other half of the holding company is held by the Michaud family of Montreal.

Castorama Dubois Investissements offered to buy the holding company, the French furniture retailer said in a separate statement. If its purchase is completed, Castorama said it would bid for the remaining 9.8 percent of Reno-Depot that is publicly held.
